description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Jaffna District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the postponement of local authority elections in the Jaffna Administrative District. It contains a notice of poll under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, announces the postponement of elections originally scheduled for March 9, 2023, and sets a new election date of April 25, 2023. This falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves election scheduling and administration by the Election Commission.
